title: BdStomatrix: An automated pipeline for stomatal detection, segmentation and trait extraction in Brachypodium.
description: BdStomatrix is an automated computer-vision pipeline for stomatal detection, cell segmentation, morphometry, density estimation, and spatial row and band trait extraction from Brachypodium microscopy images.
